title: Gotrade Daily: Dow Below 50,000, Intuit and AMD in Focus
summary: The Dow closed below 50,000 for the first time since June. Intuit, AMD, Ross Stores and Nvidia face the last session of a tough week.
body_markdown:
### AMD under short-seller pressure


**AMD ([AMD](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/amd/) )** lost nearly 8% on Thursday after Hunterbrook Capital disclosed a short position in the stock,[according to CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/18/stock-market-today-live-updates.html) . Hunterbrook's report alleges AMD firmware keeps turning up at a blacklisted Chinese company and three companies tied to it. AMD rejected the report as a misrepresentation of its business practices and relationships,[according to Semafor](https://www.semafor.com/article/11/19/2026/amd-shares-fall-after-report-flags-china-exposure) .


**Nvidia ([NVDA](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/nvda/) )** slid to a new 52-week low on Thursday,[according to CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/19/stock-market-today-live-updates.html) . More in[our Nvidia story](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/news/nvidia-nvda-stock-news-november-20-2026/) .


### Ross Stores and the US consumer


**Ross Stores ([ROST](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/rost/) )** expects fourth-quarter earnings of $2.16 to $2.25 a share, below the $2.28 analysts polled by LSEG expected,[according to CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/19/stocks-moving-the-most-today-live-updates.html) . It sees same-store sales rising 4% to 5%, against a StreetAccount consensus of 5.1%.


Shoppers continue to face higher food and fuel costs amid a softening labor market,[according to Reuters via Investing.com](https://investing.com/news/stock-market-news/ross-stores-sees-holiday-sales-growth-slowing-after-strong-q3-5040226) .


## Pre-Market Pulse 📊


As of CNBC's 12:19 a.m. ET update, S&P 500 futures were down 0.57%, Nasdaq 100 futures down 1.08% and Dow futures down 0.23%,[according to CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/19/stock-market-today-live-updates.html) . Week to date, the Dow is down 6.2%, and the S&P 500 and Nasdaq are down 5% each.


## Macro Note 📝


The University of Michigan's final November consumer sentiment reading is due at 10 a.m. ET,[according to FinanceCalendar](https://www.financecalendar.com/event/us-university-of-michigan-consumer-sentiment-november-2026/) . The preliminary reading rose to 51,[according to the ABA Banking Journal](https://bankingjournal.aba.com/2026/11/preliminary-consumer-sentiment-rises-in-november/) .


Today is also a[monthly options expiration](https://www.macroption.com/options-expiration-calendar/) in US markets. The 10-year Treasury yield stood at 5.04% on Thursday,[according to the US Treasury](https://home.treasury.gov/resource-center/data-chart-center/interest-rates/TextView?type=daily_treasury_yield_curve&field_tdr_date_value_month=202611) .


## Conclusion


Tonight is the last session of a tough week for Wall Street. It tests whether the AI sell-off continues, while consumer sentiment data gives the next read on US household spending ahead of the holidays.


US markets open at 9:30 a.m. ET.
